name: Local Anaesthetics: Esters, Amides and Regional Blocks

reference.source: KD Tripathi Essentials of Medical Pharmacology 8th Edition (topic map; text rewritten, no verbatim copy)
reference.pathophysiology: Ionised drug plugs open sodium pores use dependently while adrenaline vasoconstriction starves systemic uptake; lipid emulsion partitions lipophilic bupivacaine from cardiac channels, and sympathectomy drops venous return until filled.
additionalDifferentials: Ester versus amide by enzyme and allergy
Spinal versus epidural by baricity and segments
LAST versus anaphylaxis by ringing and timing
additionalInvestigations: Fractional aspiration with test dose in blocks
Lipid rescue stocked where bupivacaine used
Coagulation screen before neuraxial in anticoagulated
